name: mnemonic_causal_decay
label: Echoing Unravel
godotFeature: Procedural Mesh Generation & Real-time Physics Collision Shape Updates (ArrayMesh, MeshDataTool)
poeticVision: The player experiences the horrifying paradox of survival: every desperate action taken to escape the Silence's hunters actively unravels the very fabric of Lyra's past, causing the memory-worlds she traverses to visibly crumble, shift, and distort beneath her feet. The ground you fight on dissolves into forgotten echoes, each collapsing piece an agonizing fragment of self-loss. You are forced to choose between immediate survival and the slow, inevitable erasure of who you are.
usage: Attach this script to a MeshInstance3D node in your Godot scene. Ensure the MeshInstance3D has an ArrayMesh assigned to its 'Mesh' property (e.g., a PlaneMesh, BoxMesh, or imported mesh converted to ArrayMesh). As a child of this MeshInstance3D, add a CollisionShape3D node. The script will automatically find and update this CollisionShape3D. To trigger the 'Echoing Unravel' effect, call the 'apply_causal_ripple(ripple_origin: Vector3, intensity_multiplier: float = 1.0)' function from your game logic (e.g., when the player moves, attacks, or an enemy impacts the surface). The 'ripple_origin' should be a global Vector3 position where the decay effect should be centered. The 'intensity_multiplier' can be used to vary the strength of the decay.

parameters.name: decay_intensity
parameters.description: The base amount by which vertices are displaced during a decay ripple. Higher values cause more dramatic crumbling.

parameters.name: decay_radius
parameters.description: The radius around the ripple origin within which vertices will be affected by decay. Vertices further from the origin within this radius are affected less.

parameters.name: memory_fragments
parameters.description: A list of string identifiers representing memory fragments associated with this mesh segment. One fragment is 'lost' each time the segment decays.

verdict: A brilliant paradox woven into the very fabric of existence, where survival's desperate grasp shatters the echoes of self, leaving only the crumbling ruins of who you once were.
impact: This mechanic transforms the environment from a static backdrop into an active participant in Lyra's struggle. Every step, every desperate dodge, every attack against the Silence becomes a tangible act of self-destruction, forcing players into a constant, agonizing trade-off between immediate survival and the slow, inevitable erasure of Lyra's identity. It deepens the core themes of grief and loss, making the very ground beneath the player's feet a dynamic representation of Lyra's fading past, creating a uniquely horrifying and unforgettable experience.
